title: PoolMath Log Entry Failure Rate
dataSources: Whole-home water flow (`watermeter:flow`), sump pump (`sumppump:event`), well pump (`wellpump:event`), pool/spa chemistry (`pool:chemistry`), water softener (`watersoftener:status`), irrigation zones (`irrigation:zone`).
app: Smart water meters (Flume/Flo/HomeWizard), sump- and well-pump sensors, pool/spa controllers, water-softener and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=poolmath:log
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(log_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by parameter
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often PoolMath log entry records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each parameter.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize log_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per parameter.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It simply which parts of your PoolMath log entry data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
